cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Call It a Fair Win
cards.instruction: Get them to recognize the result as deserved rather than accidental, gifted, or manipulated.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Say I earned the quiz trophy, not that the questions suited me.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There were a lot of bird questions.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. I spent six months learning birds. That's preparation with feathers.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You were lucky they asked them.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And the birds were lucky I was ready. Now call it earned.
